Answer: B
Reason: Healed varicella zoster virus pneumonia is classically characterized by multiple, small (1-3 mm), randomly distributed calcified nodules throughout both lungs; this pattern distinguishes it from the upper-lobe predominance of tuberculosis or the hilar adenopathy often seen in histoplasmosis. Although the automated tools did not explicitly identify these subtle findings, Option B accurately describes the pathognomonic radiographic appearance of healed VZVP.
